question: Where can I find a zoo that lie within 170 kilometers toward the southwest side of MAC 650 Gallery, Middletown, CT?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'zoo' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MAC 650 Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Middletown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 170000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MAC 650 Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Middletown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
